name: Default service accounts
description: Fail namespaces with no non-default ServiceAccount and default ServiceAccounts that may automount API tokens.
long_description: ISM-2143 (partial): Kubescape findings show that scanned namespaces include a non-default ServiceAccount and that the default ServiceAccount disables token automount. Kyverno PolicyReports provide admission-time evidence for the corresponding policies. Neither proves that each workload uses its own account or that credentials are unique across workloads and environments, or says anything about credentials held outside Kubernetes service accounts.
remediation: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount for each namespace that needs Kubernetes API access, and set automountServiceAccountToken: false on each default ServiceAccount.

provenance.rationale: The local detector combines C-0189's checks for default-account token automount and a dedicated non-default ServiceAccount in each scanned namespace.
